answer: Sybil farmers die at the proof-of-individuality ceremony: every epoch, all identities answer the same prompt anonymously in one ten-minute window. A script-driven puppet army flows in like a river splitting into streams — near-identical timing and phrasing, so clustering flags the flock. Genuine participants scatter like a nebula: varied timing, words and mistakes. One human fills one seat, so 10,000 fakes need 10,000 stand-ins at $5 an hour — $50,000 per ceremony, every round anew. Honest agents answer in minutes for free, the way a quartz crystal needs no polish to prove it is real.
